disconfirming_questions: Does accepting git push let a remediator widen a PR without a stacked child? No: first_publication_gate enforces file scope at push time and protocol cannot see the PR file list
Does the mirror-directory mapping over-select? tests/skills/<name>/ holds only that skill's tests, at most three files today
Could a skill tests directory be root-ignored and become an unrunnable target? _drop_unrunnable still filters it
Does a tests/ change alone still select itself? Yes: infer_test_path returns test files unchanged and directory collapsing dedupes them under the mirror directory
assumed_false_ifs: CANONICAL_LAW carries a later dated section retracting the in-scope git push route
